title: Tucker Kraft: Disappointing that fans booed us at Lambeau Field, won't help us win

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Tucker Kraft: Disappointing that fans booed us at Lambeau Field, won't help us win
sources.description: "It'd be much easier with the 70,000 people behind us rather than opposing us," Kraft said of the Packers fans who booed during the 35-14 loss.
